label: Heart rate
biology: Number of heartbeats per minute. Interpret with activity, personal resting reference, symptoms, and measurement time.

label: Systolic blood pressure
biology: Arterial pressure during heart contraction. Read with diastolic pressure and the conditions under which the measurement was taken.

label: Diastolic blood pressure
biology: Arterial pressure between contractions. A change can reflect different influences from a change in systolic pressure.

label: Blood glucose
biology: Concentration of glucose in blood. Meal timing and the sampling method are important context for comparison.

label: Body temperature
biology: Recorded body temperature. Core and skin measurements have different meanings; check the measurement site and activity.

label: Respiratory rate
biology: Breaths per minute. Frequency alone does not reveal breath depth or establish adequate ventilation.

label: Oxygen saturation (SpO₂)
biology: Optical estimate of haemoglobin oxygen saturation. It does not measure haemoglobin concentration or directly quantify tissue oxygen delivery.

label: Sleep duration
biology: Amount of sleep recorded for an interval. Daily totals describe duration, not sleep quality or circadian alignment.

label: Mood
biology: Self-reported mood on the configured scale. It records experience rather than a psychiatric diagnosis.

label: Stress
biology: Self-reported stress. Compare observations within the same person and scale, alongside workload and sleep.

label: Fluid intake
biology: Recorded volume consumed during an interval. Intake alone does not establish hydration or fluid balance.

label: Body mass
biology: Body mass can reflect fluid, lean tissue, or fat changes. The measurement method and mission phase matter.

label: Preflight radiation rate
biology: Recorded preflight radiation rate. Its annual unit differs from the daily dose-rate units used in flight.

label: Preflight career radiation dose
biology: Exposure accumulated before this mission. It contributes historical context to the career exposure record.

label: Personal radiation dose rate
biology: Personal exposure per unit time. Duration is needed to connect rate with accumulated dose.

label: Mission cumulative dose
biology: Dose accumulated within the selected mission. It is not the same quantity as career dose.

label: Total career dose
biology: Recorded accumulated career exposure, including preflight history. It is not an estimate of an individual diagnosis.

label: Cabin CO₂ partial pressure
biology: Carbon dioxide pressure in the cabin atmosphere. Exposure duration and ventilation context are necessary for interpretation.

label: Cabin O₂ partial pressure
biology: Oxygen’s contribution to total gas pressure. It is not oxygen percentage and is not blood oxygen saturation.

label: Total cabin pressure
biology: Total atmospheric pressure. Both the level and the rate of pressure change matter during transitions.

label: Cabin temperature
biology: Air temperature in a habitat zone. It contributes thermal context but does not measure core body temperature.

label: Relative humidity
biology: Water-vapour content relative to saturation at that temperature. It provides context for comfort, surfaces, and heat exchange.

label: Cabin noise
biology: Sound exposure in A-weighted decibels. Duration, sleep versus work, and the averaging method matter.

label: Dust concentration
biology: Suspended particulate concentration. Particle properties and exposure duration affect what a concentration means biologically.

label: Cabin radiation dose rate
biology: Cabin-area dose rate. Shielding and location can make this different from a personal dosimeter reading.

label: Solar storm present
biology: A source-supplied event flag. It does not quantify the dose received by a crew member.

label: Consciousness / alertness
unit: Alert / new confusion / voice / pain / unresponsive
biology: Recorded alertness or response category. New confusion and reduced responsiveness are distinct from an ordinary mood score.

label: Acute early-warning score (NEWS2 total)
biology: Recorded early-warning score. BioOrbit’s space-adjusted rules are a prototype, and missing components must not be assumed normal.

label: Heart-rate variability
biology: Variation in intervals between heartbeats, expressed here as RMSSD. Activity, recording duration, and signal quality affect comparisons.

label: ECG rhythm, ST and QT flags
biology: A categorical finding from an electrical-heart assessment. A device flag needs its tracing and context for interpretation.

label: End-tidal CO2
biology: CO₂ near the end of exhalation. It relates to ventilation and circulation, and differs from cabin-air CO₂.

label: Carboxyhaemoglobin (SpCO)
biology: An optical estimate of carboxyhaemoglobin. This is a different haemoglobin species from oxygen-bound haemoglobin.

label: Methaemoglobin (SpMet)
biology: An optical estimate of methaemoglobin. It describes altered haemoglobin chemistry, not cabin oxygen concentration.

label: Perfusion index
biology: A device-derived indicator of the pulsatile optical signal relative to its background. It is not a direct cardiac-output measurement.

label: Haemoglobin, non-invasive (SpHb)
biology: Non-invasive haemoglobin estimate. Interpret with device performance and distinguish it from a laboratory haemoglobin result.

label: Haemoglobin (lab)
biology: Laboratory concentration of the oxygen-carrying protein in red cells. Fluid-volume changes can influence concentration.

label: Haematocrit
biology: Fraction of blood volume occupied by red cells. It depends on cell populations and plasma volume.

label: Platelets
biology: Count of cells involved in clot formation. A count alone does not establish normal clotting or rule out thrombosis.

label: White cells and lymphocytes
biology: White-cell count. Total and differential cell counts provide different information; the stored total does not identify every cell subtype.

label: Serum calcium
biology: Calcium concentration in blood. Regulation can maintain serum levels despite changes in skeletal calcium turnover.

label: 25-OH vitamin D
biology: 25-hydroxyvitamin D provides context for vitamin D status. It is not a direct measurement of bone density.

label: Creatinine
biology: A waste-product concentration used in renal assessment. Muscle-related factors and assay context also affect interpretation.

label: Sodium (serum)
biology: Serum sodium relates to water and electrolyte regulation. It is not a direct measure of total dietary salt intake.

label: Potassium (serum)
biology: Serum potassium supports interpretation of electrolyte balance. Sampling conditions and renal context are relevant.

label: Cortisol : DHEA ratio (saliva)
biology: Ratio of two salivary hormone measurements. Timing and assay methods matter; it is not equivalent to reported stress.

label: Herpes virus DNA (saliva/urine)
biology: Detected or undetected viral DNA in the sampled material. Detection does not automatically establish symptomatic illness.

label: Urine specific gravity and pH
biology: Specific gravity describes urine concentration, while pH describes acidity. They are separate values with different interpretations.

label: Urinary calcium
biology: Calcium excreted during a collection period. This connects urinary chemistry with bone turnover and stone-risk research.

label: Bone resorption markers (NTX)
biology: A marker related to breakdown of bone collagen. Baseline-relative values need consistent sampling and assay conditions.

label: Urine volume
biology: Urine collected over a defined period. Interpret alongside intake, losses, collection completeness, and chemistry.

label: Urine colour
biology: Categorical appearance of urine. It can provide context but is not a quantitative hydration or kidney-function test.

label: Flank pain or blood in urine
biology: A symptom flag covering flank pain or blood in urine. The flag alone does not identify the cause.

label: Cannot pass urine / painful urination
biology: Reported inability or difficulty passing urine. It is a symptom observation that needs its own clinical context.

label: Bone density (DXA)
biology: A density assessment recorded relative to pre-mission data. Density and fracture resistance are related but distinct concepts.

label: Resistance exercise done vs planned
biology: Recorded resistance-exercise sessions. Completion describes a countermeasure, not the measured muscle or bone response.

label: Exercise minutes
biology: Time spent exercising during a collection window. Duration alone does not specify intensity or mechanical loading.

label: Aerobic capacity (VO2max)
biology: An aerobic-capacity observation. Check whether a record is baseline-relative or an absolute oxygen-uptake measurement before comparison.

label: Muscle strength
biology: Performance on a strength assessment relative to a reference. The task and muscle group determine what can be compared.

label: Food energy intake
biology: Recorded food energy over a daily interval. Intake is different from energy expenditure and nutrient adequacy.

label: New blur or blind spot (SANS symptom)
biology: A report of altered vision. It does not establish SANS or identify the affected eye structures.

label: Retinal thickness around optic disc (OCT)
biology: Change in retinal nerve-fibre-layer thickness measured with OCT. Imaging protocol and the preflight comparison matter.

label: Visual acuity and Amsler grid
biology: A structured record of visual acuity and reported distortion. These examine different aspects of visual function.

label: Neck-vein (internal jugular) flow
biology: An observed neck-vein flow category. Stasis, reversed flow, and a reported clot are distinct findings.

label: Standing tolerance (BP/HR on standing)
biology: Symptoms and paired blood-pressure/heart-rate observations during upright challenge. The gravity and testing protocol matter.

label: Motion sickness
biology: Severity of reported motion sickness. Interpret relative to gravity transitions and exposure history.

label: Balance / dizziness
biology: A balance or dizziness check-in score. It is not a direct measurement of the vestibular organs.

label: Hearing thresholds
biology: Hearing threshold in dB HL. This functional test uses a different scale from cabin sound exposure in dBA.

label: Headache
biology: Reported headache severity. Many physiological and environmental influences are possible; the score does not establish a cause.

label: Infection signs (rash, cold sores, shingles pain, fever)
biology: A checklist of observed findings. Symptoms must be distinguished from laboratory confirmation of an infection.

label: Skin: rash, dryness, cut, abrasion
biology: A structured description of a skin finding. Current simulator records do not contain real clinical photographs.

label: Aches and injuries
biology: Reported pain severity and anatomical location. Pain location does not by itself establish an injury mechanism.

label: Medication taken and stock
biology: A record of medication use and stock. It is contextual information, not evidence of treatment effectiveness.

label: Sleep timing / circadian alignment
biology: Recorded sleep timing, such as midpoint. Timing alignment is a different question from total sleep duration.

label: Workload (Bedford) / effort (Borg CR10)
biology: Bedford workload and Borg perceived-effort scores are separate subjective scales and should not be merged into one quantity.

label: Reaction time (3-min PVT-B)
biology: Response latency during a vigilance task. Practice, timing, and task protocol affect interpretation.

label: Cognition battery (10 tests)
biology: A baseline-relative cognitive-assessment score. It represents the configured task battery rather than all cognitive function.

label: Team cohesion / conflict
biology: A survey-based account of team functioning. It is distinct from an individual biological assay.

label: Heart rate during spacewalk
biology: Heart rate during a spacewalk, recorded relative to an age-predicted maximum. It is not the same unit as beats per minute.

label: Core temperature during spacewalk
biology: Core temperature during a spacewalk. Interpret alongside metabolic workload and suit thermal conditions.

label: Suit pressure, O2, CO2, metabolic rate
biology: Structured suit pressure, oxygen, CO₂, and metabolic-rate values. Each component has its own unit and physiological role.

label: Decompression sickness symptoms
biology: Symptoms recorded after pressure transitions. A symptom checklist does not confirm or exclude decompression sickness.

label: Dust exposure symptoms (eyes, throat, cough)
biology: Reported eye, throat, or respiratory symptoms around dust exposure. Co-occurrence does not prove the dust caused them.

label: Solar particle event (proton flux, NOAA S-scale)
biology: A structured event-level record with a solar-radiation-storm category and projected dose. A projection is not a measured personal dose.

label: Blood-forming organ dose
biology: A blood-forming-organ dose quantity. Its mGy-Eq unit cannot be directly substituted for effective dose in mSv.

label: Acute radiation sickness symptoms
biology: A checklist of symptoms that may have many causes. It does not establish radiation exposure or acute radiation syndrome.

label: Combustion products (CO, HCN, HCl, HF)
biology: Concentrations of specific combustion products. Different chemicals have different biological mechanisms and exposure implications.

label: Drinking water available
biology: Water available per person per day. Shared supply is distinct from what an individual actually drinks.
